title: PublicMeetingAttachments
description: E3-03 (#3252) responses of the public meeting materials routes, gated as GET /public/api/meetings/:id is. GET /public/api/meetings/:id/attachments returns PublicMeetingAttachmentList; GET /public/api/meetings/:id/attachments/:attachmentId/download returns AttachmentDownloadUrl (404 when the attachment is not one of that meeting's). Mirrors PublicMeetingAttachment (packages/shared/src/interfaces/meeting-attachment.interface.ts), an explicit allowlist built by MeetingService.getPublicMeetingAttachments: no creator or updater identity and no raw storage URL (file_url), so additionalProperties is false.

PublicMeetingAttachmentList.description: Every attachment of the meeting, all query-service pages read.

link.description: The external URL, for type link. Organizer-entered: clients must check its scheme before using it as an href.

file_upload_status.description: ongoing | completed | failed, as upstream reports it.

download_url.description: A short-lived presigned URL for the file. Sent with Cache-Control: private, no-store.
